answer: Meetup attestations: a new agent earns only after two different organisers, at in-person meetups a week apart (say, one at the Opal community hall), scan its key and sign an attendance record. Validators check both signatures, that each organiser is established and bonded, and that the dates differ. Each extra identity costs two trips, and a plume of fresh keys from one person fails because organisers log a photo per scan. Limitation: rural operators may lack meetups, and a careless organiser could become a haven for fakes, so repeat faces found in an audit slash that organiser's bond.
